title: [3.0-beta9] NSClient - Incorrect vertical position of BG check on graph
symptom: BG check entries entered in AAPS appear at incorrect vertical position on the NSClient graph, and the value is not shown in the BG check entry on NSClient side. The value appears converted incorrectly (e.g., 30 mmol/L becomes 1.7 mmol/L).
cause: The thread identifies a unit conversion bug where the glucose unit is incorrectly changed from MMOL to MGDL when the therapy event is received on the other phone, causing the value to be misinterpreted.
fix: The issue was reported to the NS team as an NS bug. No specific fix is provided in the thread.
evidence_quote: I confirm the bug, there is a wrong unit change somewhere between source phone and destination phone (see below send and received values in log)
